objections.objection: Will every imported label remain searchable after migration?
objections.concern_acknowledgment: Searchability across labels, workspaces, methods, and time is important to verify.
objections.supported_response: M4 reports that labels imported from CSV were searchable immediately after import in the sample workspace.
objections.limitation: M4 covers one sample workspace and CSV import only; it did not test later reindexing or other import methods.

rejected_supplied_claims.claim: All labels stay searchable forever, regardless of migration method.
rejected_supplied_claims.rejection_reason: M4 supports only immediate searchability for CSV-imported labels in one sample workspace and does not establish permanence, all labels, all workspaces, or all methods.

objections.next_question: Can you provide tests covering other import methods, additional workspaces, and searchability after reindexing?
